# ReservoirTimescaleHierarchy

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate assignment of different time constants to different reservoir modules, creating a hierarchy of memory and processing speeds. This enables the reservoir to capture both fast and slow dynamics in input streams, improving performance on tasks with multi-scale temporal structure.
